keywords = [
]
abilities = [
    # [0]
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=TurnPhaseEvent(
            phase=Phase.COMBAT,
            actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        ),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QConst(value=1),
            quantity=QCount(
                selector=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            FAtom(
                                pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
                                count=QConst(value=4),
                                field=QPropField.POWER,
                            ),
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
            'count': QConst(value=1),
            'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
            'target': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        }),
    ),
    # [1]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),
]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
